copy_local_to_s3: copy a local file or directory to an S3 bucket using S3StorageService
copy_s3_to_local: download a file or directory from S3 to local storage using S3StorageService
copy_s3_to_s3: copy a file or directory between S3 buckets using S3StorageService
delete_s3_object: delete an S3 object by its URL using S3StorageService delete method
list_s3_files: list all files in an S3 folder recursively using S3StorageService list_files
